notes.title: Playlists? Collections!
Regions!
notes.content:
You asked us to add a region-based filtering of servers, we have done it!
Now server creators when adding or editing a server can specify belonging to a certain region.

We have removed the filter "Hide full servers" and added a filter by region instead. It is possible to select several options at once.

Available regions:
[list]
[*] Russia
[*] Europe
[*] Asia
[*] North America
[*] South America
[*] Africa
[/list]

notes.title: Saido is available!
notes.content:
Hi!
You may not know about us yet, but we are creating a unique application for comfortable gaming on community servers. Our team truly believes that it is game servers that can drive the gaming industry. Testing their game mechanics on custom community servers allows developers to quickly test their hypotheses on potential players.

In recent years, it has become very difficult to create your own game servers, and even more so to attract new players to them. The huge number of fake servers in already existing browsers, and the ignoring of community servers by game creators, only add to the problems.

That is why we have created an application that will allow you to find communities that you like, as well as easily connect to any server. For server creators we are developing an API, which will significantly increase the features of current game servers. For example, we have already implemented fast downloading of users' content (FastDL) and do not plan to stop there.

We will be glad if you install our application and find a place to have a good time with friends or find new friends.
